title: libp2p RSA DER decoding can block the Node event loop before authentication
summary: Malformed length fields in a public key cause an unbounded synchronous loop and large transient allocation. Repeated Identify messages can repeatedly stall the process or exhaust its memory.

severity.rationale: A remote peer can deny service through a cryptographic parser before identity checks. The documented impact is CPU and memory exhaustion.

exposure: js-libp2p nodes processing untrusted Identify public keys can reach the decoder before peer identity or signature checks.

params.instructions: Check @libp2p/crypto version and the documented exposure conditions against the cited advisory.

remediation.action: Update or contain the affected component
remediation.risk: Medium. Updates can interrupt workflows and require compatibility checks.

verification: Confirm the deployed component uses the patched release and test the affected workflow with harmless inputs.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.
